## What it is

Rear bay that bolts to the housing backplate and holds an Arduino UNO R4 WiFi on four standoffs, with a removable cover, cable slot, capacitor channel and a zip-tie eye for the external 5 V lead.

## Design notes

- Prints floor-down. Standoffs, nut pockets, connector slots and vents all open upward, so the part needs no supports.
- Board origin (USB/barrel edge, analog edge) sits at housing `(-40, 10)`. Mounting holes are the official ABX00087 T8 coordinates.
- Standoffs are 6 mm tall with a blind Ø4.1 mm hole, 5 mm deep, for a ruthex RX-M3Sx4.0 insert. M3×6 screws come down through the Ø3.2 mm board holes.
- USB-C and barrel slots are open at the rim (the cover caps them). The 5 V notch is on the wiring-bay wall, with a teardrop zip-tie eye beside it.
- The floor slot lines up with the housing's existing upper-right window so the matrix leads pass through without a new cut in the bezel.

## Don't

- Don't lower the shell below housing Y = -16. The original base-mount pillars occupy the backplate up to Y = -20.
- Don't close the connector slots with a bridge. A 14 mm crown over the barrel plug sags; the cover is the cap.
- Don't run the heat-set hole through the floor. The insert needs the 1 mm of plastic under it.
